subject: general
question:
Which of the following letter-clusters should replace # and % so that the pattern and relationship followed between the letter-cluster pair on the left side of :: is the same as that on the right side of :: ?

# : VXB :: ACG : %
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d16e50abe1a866069dc7ff61c99f97f83c1c43a73bc7da4d0c011f370fc1dfe.png] The logic followed here is: +1 in the positional value of the letter. Thus, # - UWA, % - BDH, ⇒ GIM : VXB :: ACG : KMQ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fb7ebf66e1c731e21c6157e37654c659eb88d41280290fb792360cd40833fb1e.png] ⇒Here, similar pattern can be seen.
